Dear Prity,

Happy birthday! I wanted to give you something a little different this year — a small place filled with good wishes, made just for you.

May your day have the simplest, best things: laughter that comes easily, your favourite treats, and the people who make you feel at home.

With your wedding ahead and a new year on the horizon, there is so much waiting to unfold. I hope every new beginning brings kindness, companionship and the freedom to keep being wonderfully yourself.

And through it all, may there always be room for your own dreams, your little joys, and friendships that keep cheering you on.

Here's to you, and all that's ahead.
— Your friend
